name: PR439 frozen W3 + W6 six-seed characterization (post ERR-010-004 / ERR-011-014 rerun)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr439-w3-six-seed-rerun-20260923

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pr439-w3-six-seed-rerun-20260923
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  measure:
    name: Run frozen #435 six-seed corpus on exact PR439 head
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      EXPECTED_MEASURED_SHA: bab4cd41b232cbbe4820279e7d456c505bdab77b
      REASON: "PR #439 rerun of the identical frozen #435 corpus after gameplay changes ERR-010-004 and ERR-011-014 (supersedes f40f085 run 35814050060 for the landing head)"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact measured PR head
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: bab4cd41b232cbbe4820279e7d456c505bdab77b

      - name: Verify measured tree
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          actual="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          echo "Measured tree: $actual"
          test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_MEASURED_SHA"

      - name: Set up .NET 8
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Resolve canonical instrument
        shell: bash
        env:
          INSTRUMENT: foul-rate
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py validate --repo .
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py resolve             "$INSTRUMENT" --repo . --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build gate and run frozen instrument
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/measurements/trx
          OUT="artifacts/measurements/measurement.txt"
          MEASURE_OUT="artifacts/measurements/instrument-output.txt"
          RESULTS="artifacts/measurements/trx"
          RUNSETTINGS="artifacts/measurements/measurement.runsettings"

          cat > "$RUNSETTINGS" <<'XML'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <RunSettings>
            <RunConfiguration>
              <TreatNoTestsAsError>true</TreatNoTestsAsError>
            </RunConfiguration>
          </RunSettings>
          XML

          {
            echo "# Frozen #435 / PR439 combined W3 + W6 characterization"
            echo "# workflow event SHA: $GITHUB_SHA"
            echo "# measured commit:    $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            echo "# ref:                $GITHUB_REF"
            echo "# run:                $GITHUB_RUN_ID (attempt $GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT)"
            echo "# instrument:         $MEASUREMENT_INSTRUMENT"
            echo "# env:                $MEASUREMENT_ENV"
            echo "# filter:             $MEASUREMENT_FILTER"
            echo "# project:            $MEASUREMENT_PROJECT"
            echo "# reason:             $REASON"
            echo "# taken:              $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
            echo
          } > "$OUT"

          set +e
          env -u "$MEASUREMENT_ENV" bash tools/dotnet-ci/run-gate.sh             --test-filter "$MEASUREMENT_FILTER" 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUT"
          gate_status="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
          set -e
          if [ "$gate_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "# build gate exit status: $gate_status" >> "$OUT"
            exit "$gate_status"
          fi

          echo >> "$OUT"
          echo "── Proved measurement run ───────────────────────────────────────────" | tee -a "$OUT"

          set +e
          env "$MEASUREMENT_ENV=1" dotnet test "$MEASUREMENT_PROJECT"             --no-build --no-restore             --filter "$MEASUREMENT_FILTER"             --settings "$RUNSETTINGS"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"             --logger "trx;LogFileName=measurement.trx"             --results-directory "$RESULTS" 2>&1 | tee "$MEASURE_OUT" | tee -a "$OUT"
          measurement_status="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
          set -e

          echo >> "$OUT"
          echo "# dotnet measurement exit status: $measurement_status" >> "$OUT"
          if [ "$measurement_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit "$measurement_status"
          fi

          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py verify-run             "$MEASUREMENT_INSTRUMENT" --trx-dir "$RESULTS" --output "$MEASURE_OUT" | tee -a "$OUT"

          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/parse_foul_card_characterization.py             "$MEASURE_OUT"             --report-out artifacts/measurements/report.txt             --tsv-out artifacts/measurements/results.tsv             --json-out artifacts/measurements/results.json

          echo "# measurement verification: PASS" >> "$OUT"

      - name: Record hashes
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -d artifacts/measurements ]; then
            (
              cd artifacts/measurements
              find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0                 | sort -z                 | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
            )
          fi

      - name: Upload measurement evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr439-w3-six-seed-rerun-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/measurements/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90
